header: Benefits at the studio behind Desiderio
subheadline: We invest in what helps people do good work for many years.

perks.title: Health first
perks.description: Full health cover and no crunch periods. Steady releases matter more than weekend work.

perks.title: Remote across Europe
perks.description: Work from anywhere in EU time zones, with a home-office budget and two team weeks a year in Vienna.

perks.title: Flexible hours
perks.description: You plan your own day. We look at finished work and passing audits, not at when you start.

perks.title: Conference budget
perks.description: TYPO3 camps, accessibility meetups, books and courses, paid from a yearly budget that needs no approval.

perks.title: Open-source time
perks.description: Paid hours every week for Desiderio itself: sort issues, improve atoms or design the next preset.

perks.title: No-meeting Fridays
perks.description: We hold no meetings on Fridays. Most of the 62 components got their final polish on a Friday.
